IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Brown, Brandland, Kohl-Welles and Rasmussen; by request of Attorney General

Bill.BriefDescription: Expanding the crime of communicating with a minor for immoral purposes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to communication with a minor for immoral purposes;and amending RCW 9.68A.090.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9.68A.090 and 1989 c 32 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person who communicates with a minor for immoral purposes, or aperson who communicates with someone the person believes to be a minorfor immoral purposes, is guilty of a gross misdemeanor, unless thatperson has previously been convicted under this section or of a felonysexual offense under chapter 9.68A, 9A.44, or 9A.64 RCW or of any otherfelony sexual offense in this or any other state, in which case theperson is guilty of a class C felony punishable under chapter 9A.20RCW.
